question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Ambrosial
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Ambrosial"** refers to something extremely pleasing to taste or smell, often described as divine or heavenly. (स्वादिष्ट/सुगंधित)

 
 
• **Example:** The freshly baked bread had an ambrosial aroma that filled the entire house.
 
 
 
• **"Malodorous"** refers to something having an unpleasant or foul smell. (दुर्गंधयुक्त)
 
 
• **Example:** The garbage dump was malodorous and made it difficult to stay nearby for long.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can conclude that the antonym of **"Ambrosial"** is **"Malodorous"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Faithful** (विश्वसनीय): Someone who is loyal and trustworthy.

 
 
• **Example:** A faithful dog always stays by its owner’s side.
 
 
 
• **Pleasing** (आकर्षक): Something that brings happiness or satisfaction.
 
 
• **Example:** The soothing music was very pleasing to the ears.
 
 
 
• **Vengeful** (प्रतिशोधी): Having or showing a desire to seek revenge.
 
 
• **Example:** The vengeful character in the story sought to harm those who wronged him.
